name: Skechers Viper Court Pro
description: The Skechers Viper Court Pro is a dedicated pickleball shoe built for quick lateral movement at the kitchen line. A Goodyear Performance rubber outsole with a herringbone tread grips both outdoor hard courts and indoor floors, while a lightweight Arch Fit insole and responsive cushioning midsole reduce fatigue over long sessions. A reinforced toe cap protects against drag during low volleys.
care_instructions: Brush off court dust after play and wipe the upper with a damp cloth. Remove the insole and air dry at room temperature; never put the shoes in a dryer or near a heater.
